question: A buyer gets two successive discounts of 20% and 10% on a Rs. 1000 item. What is the price paid?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective single discount for 20% and 10% = 20 + 10 − (20 × 10)/100 = 28%.

Final Selling Price = 100% − 28% = 72% of Marked Price.

Final Price = (72/100) × 1000 = 720.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹720.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹1000

First discount = 20%

Second discount = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − D₁/100) × (1 − D₂/100)
